title: galium sylvaticum subsp. aristatum
intro: Galium sylvaticum subsp. aristatum, commonly known as the aristate bedstraw, is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include the relief of anxiety and insomnia due to its calming and sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Galium sylvaticum subsp. aristatum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as gentianine, gentianidine, and gentiadin, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids. These constituents may contribute to the plant's therapeutic actions, which include its sedative, anxiolytic, and spasmolytic effects.
